note: Read 2026-11-03 in CVDR (lokaleregelgeving.overheid.nl), where Sint Maarten publishes its own regulations (creator 'Sint Maarten'); the earlier round's note that CVDR holds only texts from before 2010 was wrong for Sint Maarten. Majority: 18. Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 1 (CVDR142362/3, in force from 30-05-2015), art. 233: minors are those who haven't reached eighteen and aren't or haven't been married or declared of age under art. 253ha (neither held). Work: 15. The Landsverordening on working hours, working times and overtime (CVDR682033/1, in force from 01-10-2022), art. 1: 'kinderen' are those under fifteen; art. 18 bars having children work, paid or not, under a contract or not; art. 19(2) lets a landsbesluit exempt work by children from twelve (learning a trade, work children usually do, light work, each outside school hours and between 07:00 and 19:00). Performers: barred. No landsbesluit under art. 19(2) was found: CVDR's SRU service, queried 2026-11-03 for Sint Maarten's regulations titled 'Arbeidsregeling', 'arbeidsduur', 'kinderarbeid' and 'jeugdigen', holds only the Landsverordening's versions and two landsbesluiten under the Arbeidsregeling's articles 21(2) and 27 (hotels and restaurants), so no exception lets a child under fifteen perform. The person research (person.ages.SX) reads the Netherlands Antilles' Labour Regulations 2000 in the Kingdom's 2006 report to the same fifteen; this file reads Sint Maarten's own text in force. Service: men, registered from the day they turn 18 until the day they turn 45; the first training at most twelve months (longer for officer and NCO training, not held). Landsverordening tot regeling van de dienstplicht (CVDR141941/2, in force from 30-05-2015), art. 1 and 8, art. 27; whether anyone is called in practice wasn't read.

sources.title: LANDSVERORDENING tot regeling van de dienstplicht (Sint Maarten), geldend van 30-05-2015 t/m heden, CVDR
sources.said: Onder de ingevolge deze landsverordening voor de dienstplicht in te schrijven personen worden uitsluitend mannelijke personen verstaan. ... Artikel 8 1. Voor de dienstplicht wordt ... ingeschreven: a. de Nederlander, die op de dag, waarop hij 18 jaar oud wordt en tot de dag, waarop hij 45 jaar oud wordt in het bevolkingsregister in zijn woonplaats is opgenomen ... Artikel 27 1. De duur van de eerste oefening bedraagt ten hoogste 12 maanden.
